question: Who resigned as Chief minister of Maharashtra following Supreme Court of India not admitting the stay petition of Shiv Sena against the Motion of no confidence in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uddhav Thackeray.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uddhav Thackeray **was the** Chief Minister** of **Maharashtra **from **November 2019 **to **June 2022.**
 
• He belonged to the **Shiv Sena party**, which is a **regional political party** in Maharashtra.
 
• Thackeray's resignation came after the** Supreme Court of India** did not admit the stay petition of **Shiv Sena** against the Motion of **no confidence **in **June 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Devendra Fadnavis** was the **Chief Minister of Maharashtra** from **2014 to 2019** and belonged to the **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP).
 
• **Eknath Shinde** is a **senior Shiv Sena leader** and currently serves as the **Minister for Urban Development** in the Maharashtra government.
 
• **Urmila Matondkar **is a** Bollywood actress** who contested the **2019 Lok Sabha elections** from Mumbai North constituency on a Congress ticket but lost to BJP's Gopal Shetty.
 
• Hence, the **correct **answer to the question is option 1, i.e., Uddhav Thackeray.
